summary: Kazia Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwritten public offering of ADSs and warrants, raising approximately $40 million. The offering comprises 2,276,800 ADSs, pre-funded warrants, Series A warrants (exercise price $17.825, 115% of offering price), and Series B warrants ($19.375, 125%). Underwriters include Leerink and Guggenheim, with BTIG and Needham as lead managers. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds fund clinical development of paxalisib. Closing expected August 31, 2026. Routine financing; no special-situation angle.
